in_sanskrit.name: Ranish
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Rain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ranish एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ranish is derived from the Sanskrit language and translates to 'Lord of the Rain'. This powerful and evocative name is perfect for a baby boy born during the monsoon season, or for one whose parents wish to bestow upon him the blessings of the rain god.
